name: TPC Boston
architects: Arnold Palmer (opened 2002); redesigned by Gil Hanse with Brad Faxon (2007); 18th green rebuilt 2011-12 (tpc.com, Wikipedia)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth elevation (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, float32, NAD83 / UTM 19N EPSG:26919, 1 m pixels, world + 100 m; the service's 1 m source here is the 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts, flown 20 Mar - 24 Apr 2021); NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-21 (GitHub release data-tpc-boston, exportImage.10.tiff)

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1473646), clipped to the course box, classes 2-6 delivered (3-5 used); NAD83(2011) / Massachusetts Mainland metres, NAVD88 metres; flown early April 2021 (GPS times), leaf-off; ordered by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release data-tpc-boston, ma2021_cent_east_J1473646.zip)
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (way 311851822, 1,478 x 2,020 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,792 m east-west (157 m each side), 2,304 m north-south (142 m each side). Over the 2,048 m limit (as Oregon Golf Club's 2,304 m); the alternative, 2,048 m, leaves 14 m at each end. Approved by the developer 2026-10-20.

scorecard_source: The club's 2024 printed scorecard (2024_Scorecard.pdf in GitHub release data-tpc-boston; also tpc.com/boston/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2024/11/2024_Scorecard.pdf), checked against the rendered card 2026-10-21: every row adds up to its printed total. Par 72 (hole 14 a par 4); Championship 7,282 77.2/154, Gold 6,990 74.6/144, Black 6,454 72.1/139, Blended 6,213 70.9/135 (total only), White 6,035 70.1/132, Blue 5,147 66.1/122 (men). OSM, Wikipedia and Stymie carry the tour card (par 73, hole 14 a par 5, another stroke index); Stymie's Black 72.4/139 and Gold 74.7/145 are not used. Built from the Black and Gold tees, Black the default (developer, 2026-10-20; the card's Blue is the forward set).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Phase 1 (2026-10-20): standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): every penalty area red, OSM boundary is OB, range OB, pins at green centres, trees from lidar, wind 1-9 mph (inland New England). Theme bayside (developer: Franklin's theme). Logo: a baby blue pair of lederhosen (developer). The 1.0 ha pond mapped only as natural=water inside the boundary (w1239408943, 98 m from hole 8) is red through red_water_osm (otherwise it would paint as rough). Norton Country Club (way 29897980) lies 74 m west, inside the world: its boundary and hole lines are dropped in edits.json, its surfaces stay as out-of-bounds scenery. Developer 2026-10-20: Black and Gold tees (Black default), the club's 2024 card (par 72, hole 14 a par 4), world 1,792 x 2,304 m. Wetlands inside the boundary mapped only as natural=wetland are red penalty areas through red_water_osm too (course chat 2026-10-21, all water red; otherwise rough): w1239419367 (marsh, 0.14 ha, under hole 11's line), w1239391361/62/66 (swamp and marsh, 0.05-0.08 ha, 11-35 m from holes 4 and 5).
